text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: ――Moving on, let's talk about the Japanese Oaks coming up this weekend!

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
Which Umamusume will claim the crown of the Queen of Oaks this year...?
Ah, I can hardly wait!

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text: Speaking of the Triple Tiara route, there's actually a girl I've had my eye on ever since the Oka Sho~!

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Sweep Tosho, right?
Man, that press conference was something else.
Talk about a big personality.

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"Changing the world with the magic of racing"!
Fufufu, that really makes you want to dream a little, doesn't it~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sweep's name came up again!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's quite a hot topic on social media and stuff too, huh!
I guess that post-Oka Sho interview really left a massive impression, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, in this article, it says the star of the Oaks is bound to be Sui-chan...
That's amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "She's the only one who can play the lead role," huh...
And now, the day of the Oaks had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Alright!!
Time to get going, familiar!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A clue to perfecting the magic of racing...
I'm definitely going to find it this time—

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me. Sorry to bother you out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
? Huh, who's this? ...Wait, aren't you
running in the Oaks with me today?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho-san.
May I have a word with you?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Talk? ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...You know... I—

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I won't lose to you, of all people!!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Changing history? Changing the world?!
If you wanna do stuff like that, you gotta beat me first!"

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're not the only one everyone should be watching on the Triple Tiara route!!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm standing here putting everything on the line, too.
My parents' wish for the Tiara, everything we've worked for each day—I'm putting it all on the line, right here!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: So――I won't let you be the only one talking about your dreams.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The glory of Queen of the Oaks!
It's not going to you, it's mine!!
A declaration making no effort to hide a blazing fighting spirit echoed proudly through Tokyo Racecourse amidst the tense air ahead of the 'Oaks.'
And then—

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor A
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah, you're right.
I... I wanted to say
the exact same thing to them...!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor B
text_block_list.text: "Me too! Ever since my mother's generation, we've been working endlessly to reach the top of the Oaks!"

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor C
text_block_list.text:
"Before you go on about the girls on the Triple Crown route,
how about you try defeating us first!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I will never yield the queen's thronnnnne!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's this?
—I'm actually getting a little excited here!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! That earlier was crazy, wasn't it?
The Oaks runners were surrounding Sweep Tosho, sparks flying everywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It felt like things were even more heated than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: With that magical girl at the center, I get the feeling... that something is gradually beginning to stir!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sweep-san... Are you—
